entry.author: RotoruaNZ
entry.summary:
It's one of life's truths that we don't dwell on enough: Whenever you are in a bathrobe...you are having a good time. You wear them at a spa.

You wear one as you lounge in a nice hotel room. And let's be honest, when you and your partner are robed up? It's something of an aphrodisiac.

In Rotorua we want to offer you all of the above on your next couples getaway. We want you to clock as much robe time as possible - because it's thoroughly invigorating.

Book your Robe Trip today rotoruanz.com/robe-trip
